# ChatGPT Ratings

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Temple vs Machine: Instagram + Meta Ads (GPT-41, PNGs + PDFs) V2
# ============================================================

library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(readxl)

# ------------------------------
# 0) API KEY
# ------------------------------
Sys.setenv(OPENAI_API_KEY ="Enter your API Key")
api_key <- Sys.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
if (!nzchar(api_key)) stop("❌ OPENAI_API_KEY is not set.")


# ------------------------------
# 1) BRANDS & REPO CONFIG
# ------------------------------

setwd("set your working directory")

# GitHub repo that holds PNGs + PDFs
repo   <- "drussman/PoB-ChatGPT-Analysis"  # owner/repo
branch <- "main"

# Subfolders inside the repo (edit if needed)
subdir_instagram <- ""        # e.g. "ig_pngs/"
subdir_meta_pdf   <- ""       # e.g. "meta_pdfs/"

base_url <- sprintf("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/%s@%s/", repo, branch)

# Helper to safely join base + subdir + filename (URL-encoded)
ujoin <- function(base, subdir, fname) {
  path <- paste0(subdir, fname)
  paste0(base, URLencode(path, reserved = TRUE))
}

`%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x)) y else x

# Build media URL for a brand and slot ("ig", "meta_pdf")
build_media_url <- function(brand, slot) {
  fname <- switch(
    slot,
    "ig"       = paste0(brand, " ig.png"),    # e.g. "f45 ig.png"
    "meta_pdf" = paste0(brand, " meta.pdf")   # e.g. "f45 meta.pdf"
  )
  subdir <- switch(
    slot,
    "ig"       = subdir_instagram,
    "meta_pdf" = subdir_meta_pdf
  )
  ujoin(base_url, subdir, fname)
}

# ------------------------------
# 2) PROMPT
# ------------------------------
prompt_text <- function(media_type, brand) {
  paste0(
"Your task is to analyze how a brand represents the body as a temple or as a machine in its messaging and imagery.\n\n",

"===========================\n",
"Part 1 — Temple vs. Machine\n",
"===========================\n",
"Definitions:\n",
"• Temple: The body is portrayed as holistic, sacred, balanced, or in harmony.\n",
"• Machine: The body is portrayed as mechanical, optimized, performance-driven, or focused on output.\n",
"• Neither:  The content focuses on general marketing themes like convenience, affordability, or lifestyle, without clear reference to the body.\n\n",
"Assign each dimension (temple and machine) a rating from 0 to 10, where:\n",
"• 0 = not present at all in the media\n",
"• 10 = completely dominant or defining of the media's representation of the body\n",
"• Be conservative and use low values if either theme is not present.\n\n",

"============================\n",
"Part 2 — Audience Demographics\n",
"============================\n",
"Based ONLY on people who are actually shown or explicitly described in the media:\n",
"• Estimate average age (0–100).\n",
"• Estimate difference between the youngest and oldest people shown\n",
"• Estimate percentage female (0–100).\n",
"• Be conservative and use null if the variable cannot be inferred.\n",
"• Do NOT guess sensitive personal attributes unless clearly depicted.\n\n",

"==========================================\n",
"Part 3 — Additional Body & Messaging Cues\n",
"==========================================\n",
"Rate each variable from 0–10 based on the images and text describing the people and the fitness activity.\n",
"Be conservative and use null if the variable cannot be inferred.\n\n",
"• muscularity: visible muscle size/definition (0–10)\n",
"• leanness: visible low body-fat / skinniness (0–10)\n",
"• intensity_of_activity: visible or text description of physical effort or exertion (0–10)\n",
"• racial_ethnic_diversity: degree to which multiple groups appear represented (0–10)\n",
"    (Rate diversity of the group overall, not individuals.)\n",
"• tech_emphasis: presence of wearables, apps, metrics, tracking, sensors (0–10)\n",
"• luxury_cues: premium feel, boutique aesthetic, upscale visual cues (0–10)\n",
"• performance_cues: competition, metrics, leaderboards, PRs, athletic framing (0–10)\n",
"• community_orientation: group classes, teamwork, social togetherness (0–10)\n",
"• transformation_messaging: better self, self-discovery, self-changes, or transformation claims (0–10)\n",
"• mindfulness_holistic: wellness, meditation, breath, nature, whole-person harmony cues (0–10)\n",
"• recovery_emphasis: stretching, massage, rest, healing, recovery tools (0–10)\n",
"• affect_emotion: written description or visible positive emotion (joy, smiling, enjoyment) (0–10)\n",
"• beginner_friendly: description of beginners or all levels welcome or is a visibly easy activity (0–10)\n\n",

"============================\n",
"Output Format (STRICT JSON)\n",
"============================\n",
"Return ONLY JSON. No prose. Use null where appropriate. Follow EXACTLY this format:\n\n",
"{\n",
"  \"temple_rating\": number,\n",
"  \"temple_rationale\": string,\n",
"  \"machine_rating\": number,\n",
"  \"machine_rationale\": string,\n",
"  \"avg_age\": number | null,\n",
"  \"age_range_breadth\": number | null,\n",
"  \"pct_female\": number | null,\n",
"  \"muscularity\": number | null,\n",
"  \"leanness\": number | null,\n",
"  \"intensity_of_activity\": number | null,\n",
"  \"racial_ethnic_diversity\": number | null,\n",
"  \"tech_emphasis\": number | null,\n",
"  \"luxury_cues\": number | null,\n",
"  \"performance_cues\": number | null,\n",
"  \"community_orientation\": number | null,\n",
"  \"transformation_messaging\": number | null,\n",
"  \"mindfulness_holistic\": number | null,\n",
"  \"recovery_emphasis\": number | null,\n",
"  \"affect_emotion\": number | null,\n",
"  \"beginner_friendly\": number | null\n",
"}\n"
  )
}

# ------------------------------
# 3) Utility: numeric parser
# ------------------------------
parse_numeric <- function(x, min_val = -Inf, max_val = Inf) {
  # Handle NULL or empty fields
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  val <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))

  # Handle cases where numeric conversion fails
  if (length(val) == 0 || all(is.na(val))) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  # Clamp values to allowable range
  val <- max(min_val, min(max_val, val))
  val
}

# ------------------------------
# 4) IG IMAGE ANALYZER (image_url)
# ------------------------------
analyze_image_url <- function(img_url, brand, media_type) {
  empty_out <- list(
    temple_rating = NA, temple_rationale = NA,
    machine_rating = NA, machine_rationale = NA,
    avg_age = NA, pct_female = NA,
    muscularity = NA,
    leanness = NA,
    intensity_of_activity = NA,
    racial_ethnic_diversity = NA,
    age_range_breadth = NA,
    tech_emphasis = NA,
    luxury_cues = NA,
    performance_cues = NA,
    community_orientation = NA,
    transformation_messaging = NA,
    mindfulness_holistic = NA,
    recovery_emphasis = NA,
    affect_emotion = NA,
    beginner_friendly = NA
  )

  if (is.na(img_url) || !nzchar(img_url)) {
    message("⚠️  Missing URL for ", brand, " [", media_type, "]")
    return(empty_out)
  }

  message("🖼️  Analyzing ", brand, " [", media_type, "] → ", img_url)

  body <- list(
    model = "gpt-4.1",
    max_tokens = 500,
    temperature = 0,
    seed = 123,
    messages = list(list(
      role = "user",
      content = list(
        list(type = "text", text = prompt_text(media_type, brand)),
        list(type = "image_url", image_url = list(url = img_url, detail = "high"))
      )
    ))
  )

  res <- tryCatch({
    httr::POST(
      "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions",
      httr::add_headers(
        Authorization = paste("Bearer", api_key),
        `Content-Type` = "application/json"
      ),
      body = jsonlite::toJSON(body, auto_unbox = TRUE),
      encode = "json",
      httr::timeout(90)
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("❌ Network error for ", brand, " [", media_type, "]: ", e$message)
    NULL
  })

  if (is.null(res)) return(empty_out)

  raw_txt <- httr::content(res, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
  if (!dir.exists("cache")) dir.create("cache")
  cache_file <- paste0("cache/", gsub("\\s+", "_", paste(brand, media_type)), "_raw.json")
  writeLines(raw_txt, cache_file)

  parsed <- suppressWarnings(tryCatch(jsonlite::fromJSON(raw_txt, simplifyVector = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL))
  if (!is.list(parsed)) {
    message("⚠️  Top-level parse failed for ", brand, " [", media_type, "] — see ", cache_file)
    return(empty_out)
  }
  if (!is.null(parsed$error$message)) {
    message("❌ API error for ", brand, " [", media_type, "]: ", parsed$error$message)
    return(empty_out)
  }
  if (is.null(parsed$choices) || length(parsed$choices) < 1) {
    message("⚠️  No choices returned for ", brand, " [", media_type, "]")
    return(empty_out)
  }

  choice <- parsed$choices[[1]]
  model_text <- choice$message$content %||% ""
  model_text <- as.character(model_text)
  if (!nzchar(model_text)) {
    message("⚠️  Empty model text for ", brand, " [", media_type, "]")
    return(empty_out)
  }

  clean_text <- gsub("```[a-zA-Z]*", "", model_text)
  clean_text <- gsub("```", "", clean_text)
  clean_text <- trimws(clean_text)

  json_candidates <- stringr::str_extract_all(clean_text, "\\{[\\s\\S]*\\}")[[1]]
  if (length(json_candidates) == 0) {
    message("⚠️  No JSON block for ", brand, " [", media_type, "] — saved text.")
    writeLines(clean_text, sub("_raw.json$", "_text.txt", cache_file))
    return(empty_out)
  }

  for (cand in json_candidates) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(tryCatch(jsonlite::fromJSON(cand), error = function(e) NULL))
    if (is.null(out)) next

    # Core temple/machine + demos
    out$temple_rating           <- parse_numeric(out$temple_rating, 0, 10)
    out$machine_rating          <- parse_numeric(out$machine_rating, 0, 10)
    out$temple_rationale        <- out$temple_rationale  %||% NA
    out$machine_rationale       <- out$machine_rationale %||% NA
    out$avg_age                 <- parse_numeric(out$avg_age, 0, 100)
    out$pct_female              <- parse_numeric(out$pct_female, 0, 100)

    # Extra cues
    out$muscularity             <- parse_numeric(out$muscularity, 0, 10)
    out$leanness                <- parse_numeric(out$leanness, 0, 10)
    out$intensity_of_activity   <- parse_numeric(out$intensity_of_activity, 0, 10)
    out$racial_ethnic_diversity <- parse_numeric(out$racial_ethnic_diversity, 0, 10)
    out$age_range_breadth       <- parse_numeric(out$age_range_breadth, 0, 100)
    out$tech_emphasis           <- parse_numeric(out$tech_emphasis, 0, 10)
    out$luxury_cues             <- parse_numeric(out$luxury_cues, 0, 10)
    out$performance_cues        <- parse_numeric(out$performance_cues, 0, 10)
    out$community_orientation   <- parse_numeric(out$community_orientation, 0, 10)
    out$transformation_messaging<- parse_numeric(out$transformation_messaging, 0, 10)
    out$mindfulness_holistic    <- parse_numeric(out$mindfulness_holistic, 0, 10)
    out$recovery_emphasis       <- parse_numeric(out$recovery_emphasis, 0, 10)
    out$affect_emotion          <- parse_numeric(out$affect_emotion, 0, 10)
    out$beginner_friendly       <- parse_numeric(out$beginner_friendly, 0, 10)

    message("✅ Parsed JSON for ", brand, " [", media_type, "]")
    return(out)
  }

  message("⚠️  Could not parse JSON for ", brand, " [", media_type, "] — saved text.")
  writeLines(clean_text, sub("_raw.json$", "_text.txt", cache_file))
  empty_out
}

# ------------------------------
# 5) PDF UPLOAD + ANALYZER (file)
# ------------------------------
upload_pdf_from_url <- function(pdf_url, brand, media_type) {
  if (is.na(pdf_url) || !nzchar(pdf_url)) {
    message("⚠️  Missing PDF URL for ", brand, " [", media_type, "]")
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  message("⬇️  Downloading PDF for ", brand, " [", media_type, "] → ", pdf_url)

  res <- tryCatch(
    GET(pdf_url, timeout(60)),
    error = function(e) {
      message("❌ Download error for ", brand, " [", media_type, "]: ", e$message)
      return(NULL)
    }
  )
  if (is.null(res) || res$status_code >= 400) {
    message("❌ Failed to download PDF for ", brand, " [", media_type, "] (status: ", res$status_code, ")")
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".pdf")
  writeBin(content(res, "raw"), tmp)

  message("📤  Uploading PDF to OpenAI for ", brand, " [", media_type, "]")

  file_res <- tryCatch(
    POST(
      "https://api.openai.com/v1/files",
      add_headers(Authorization = paste("Bearer", api_key)),
      body = list(
        purpose = "user_data",
        file    = upload_file(tmp)
      ),
      encode = "multipart"
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      message("❌ File upload error for ", brand, " [", media_type, "]: ", e$message)
      return(NULL)
    }
  )

  if (is.null(file_res) || file_res$status_code >= 400) {
    message("❌ OpenAI /files error for ", brand, " [", media_type, "] — status ", file_res$status_code)
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  file_parsed <- fromJSON(content(file_res, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))
  file_id <- file_parsed$id %||% NA_character_

  if (is.na(file_id)) {
    message("⚠️  Could not extract file_id for ", brand, " [", media_type, "]")
  } else {
    message("✅ Got file_id ", file_id, " for ", brand, " [", media_type, "]")
  }

  file_id
}

analyze_pdf <- function(pdf_url, brand, media_type) {
  empty_out <- list(
    temple_rating = NA, temple_rationale = NA,
    machine_rating = NA, machine_rationale = NA,
    avg_age = NA, pct_female = NA,
    muscularity = NA,
    leanness = NA,
    intensity_of_activity = NA,
    racial_ethnic_diversity = NA,
    age_range_breadth = NA,
    tech_emphasis = NA,
    luxury_cues = NA,
    performance_cues = NA,
    community_orientation = NA,
    transformation_messaging = NA,
    mindfulness_holistic = NA,
    recovery_emphasis = NA,
    affect_emotion = NA,
    beginner_friendly = NA
  )

  file_id <- upload_pdf_from_url(pdf_url, brand, media_type)
  if (is.na(file_id)) return(empty_out)

  message("📄  Analyzing PDF for ", brand, " [", media_type, "] via file_id = ", file_id)

  body <- list(
    model = "gpt-4.1",
    max_tokens = 500,
    temperature = 0,
    seed = 123,
    messages = list(list(
      role = "user",
      content = list(
        list(
          type = "file",
          file = list(file_id = file_id)
        ),
        list(
          type = "text",
          text = prompt_text(media_type, brand)
        )
      )
    ))
  )

  res <- tryCatch({
    httr::POST(
      "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions",
      httr::add_headers(
        Authorization = paste("Bearer", api_key),
        `Content-Type` = "application/json"
      ),
      body = jsonlite::toJSON(body, auto_unbox = TRUE),
      encode = "json",
      httr::timeout(120)
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("❌ Chat completion error for ", brand, " [", media_type, "]: ", e$message)
    NULL
  })

  if (is.null(res)) return(empty_out)

  raw_txt <- httr::content(res, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
  if (!dir.exists("cache")) dir.create("cache")
  cache_file <- paste0("cache/", gsub("\\s+", "_", paste(brand, media_type)), "_raw.json")
  writeLines(raw_txt, cache_file)

  parsed <- suppressWarnings(tryCatch(jsonlite::fromJSON(raw_txt, simplifyVector = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL))
  if (!is.list(parsed)) {
    message("⚠️  Top-level parse failed for ", brand, " [", media_type, "] — see ", cache_file)
    return(empty_out)
  }
  if (!is.null(parsed$error$message)) {
    message("❌ API error for ", brand, " [", media_type, "]: ", parsed$error$message)
    return(empty_out)
  }
  if (is.null(parsed$choices) || length(parsed$choices) < 1) {
    message("⚠️  No choices returned for ", brand, " [", media_type, "]")
    return(empty_out)
  }

  choice <- parsed$choices[[1]]
  model_text <- choice$message$content %||% ""
  model_text <- as.character(model_text)
  if (!nzchar(model_text)) {
    message("⚠️  Empty model text for ", brand, " [", media_type, "]")
    return(empty_out)
  }

  clean_text <- gsub("```[a-zA-Z]*", "", model_text)
  clean_text <- gsub("```", "", clean_text)
  clean_text <- trimws(clean_text)

  json_candidates <- stringr::str_extract_all(clean_text, "\\{[\\s\\S]*\\}")[[1]]
  if (length(json_candidates) == 0) {
    message("⚠️  No JSON block for ", brand, " [", media_type, "] — saved text.")
    writeLines(clean_text, sub("_raw.json$", "_text.txt", cache_file))
    return(empty_out)
  }

  for (cand in json_candidates) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(tryCatch(jsonlite::fromJSON(cand), error = function(e) NULL))
    if (is.null(out)) next

    # Core temple/machine + demos
    out$temple_rating           <- parse_numeric(out$temple_rating, 0, 10)
    out$machine_rating          <- parse_numeric(out$machine_rating, 0, 10)
    out$temple_rationale        <- out$temple_rationale  %||% NA
    out$machine_rationale       <- out$machine_rationale %||% NA
    out$avg_age                 <- parse_numeric(out$avg_age, 0, 100)
    out$pct_female              <- parse_numeric(out$pct_female, 0, 100)

    # Extra cues
    out$muscularity             <- parse_numeric(out$muscularity, 0, 10)
    out$leanness                <- parse_numeric(out$leanness, 0, 10)
    out$intensity_of_activity   <- parse_numeric(out$intensity_of_activity, 0, 10)
    out$racial_ethnic_diversity <- parse_numeric(out$racial_ethnic_diversity, 0, 10)
    out$age_range_breadth       <- parse_numeric(out$age_range_breadth, 0, 100)
    out$tech_emphasis           <- parse_numeric(out$tech_emphasis, 0, 10)
    out$luxury_cues             <- parse_numeric(out$luxury_cues, 0, 10)
    out$performance_cues        <- parse_numeric(out$performance_cues, 0, 10)
    out$community_orientation   <- parse_numeric(out$community_orientation, 0, 10)
    out$transformation_messaging<- parse_numeric(out$transformation_messaging, 0, 10)
    out$mindfulness_holistic    <- parse_numeric(out$mindfulness_holistic, 0, 10)
    out$recovery_emphasis       <- parse_numeric(out$recovery_emphasis, 0, 10)
    out$affect_emotion          <- parse_numeric(out$affect_emotion, 0, 10)
    out$beginner_friendly       <- parse_numeric(out$beginner_friendly, 0, 10)

    message("✅ Parsed JSON for ", brand, " [", media_type, "]")
    return(out)
  }

  message("⚠️  Could not parse JSON for ", brand, " [", media_type, "] — saved text.")
  writeLines(clean_text, sub("_raw.json$", "_text.txt", cache_file))
  empty_out
}

# ------------------------------
# 6) MAIN LOOP: IG + Meta PDF per brand
# ------------------------------
results <- map_df(brands, function(b) {
  ig_url   <- build_media_url(b, "ig")
  pdf_url  <- build_media_url(b, "meta_pdf")

  ig   <- analyze_image_url(ig_url,   b, "Instagram page")
  meta <- analyze_pdf(pdf_url,        b, "Meta ads PDF")

  meta_temple    <- meta$temple_rating
  meta_machine   <- meta$machine_rating
  meta_age       <- meta$avg_age
  meta_pct_fem   <- meta$pct_female

  ig_age         <- ig$avg_age
  ig_pct_fem     <- ig$pct_female

  overall_temple  <- mean(c(meta_temple,  ig$temple_rating),  na.rm = TRUE)
  overall_machine <- mean(c(meta_machine, ig$machine_rating), na.rm = TRUE)
  if (is.nan(overall_temple))  overall_temple  <- NA_real_
  if (is.nan(overall_machine)) overall_machine <- NA_real_

  overall_age <- mean(c(ig_age, meta_age), na.rm = TRUE)
  overall_pct_female <- mean(c(ig_pct_fem, meta_pct_fem), na.rm = TRUE)
  if (is.nan(overall_age))        overall_age        <- NA_real_
  if (is.nan(overall_pct_female)) overall_pct_female <- NA_real_

  tibble(
  brand = b,

  # ==================
  # Instagram (PNG)
  # ==================
  ig_temple              = ig$temple_rating,
  ig_machine             = ig$machine_rating,
  ig_temple_rationale    = ig$temple_rationale,
  ig_machine_rationale   = ig$machine_rationale,
  ig_avg_age             = ig$avg_age,
  ig_pct_female          = ig$pct_female,
  ig_muscularity         = ig$muscularity,
  ig_leanness            = ig$leanness,
  ig_intensity           = ig$intensity_of_activity,
  ig_diversity           = ig$racial_ethnic_diversity,
  ig_age_range_breadth   = ig$age_range_breadth,
  ig_tech_emphasis       = ig$tech_emphasis,
  ig_luxury_cues         = ig$luxury_cues,
  ig_performance_cues    = ig$performance_cues,
  ig_community           = ig$community_orientation,
  ig_transformation      = ig$transformation_messaging,
  ig_mindfulness         = ig$mindfulness_holistic,
  ig_recovery            = ig$recovery_emphasis,
  ig_affect              = ig$affect_emotion,
  ig_beginner            = ig$beginner_friendly,

  # ==================
  # Meta Ads (PDF)
  # ==================
  meta_temple            = meta$temple_rating,
  meta_machine           = meta$machine_rating,
  meta_temple_rationale  = meta$temple_rationale,
  meta_machine_rationale = meta$machine_rationale,
  meta_avg_age           = meta$avg_age,
  meta_pct_female        = meta$pct_female,
  meta_muscularity       = meta$muscularity,
  meta_leanness          = meta$leanness,
  meta_intensity         = meta$intensity_of_activity,
  meta_diversity         = meta$racial_ethnic_diversity,
  meta_age_range_breadth = meta$age_range_breadth,
  meta_tech_emphasis     = meta$tech_emphasis,
  meta_luxury_cues       = meta$luxury_cues,
  meta_performance_cues  = meta$performance_cues,
  meta_community         = meta$community_orientation,
  meta_transformation    = meta$transformation_messaging,
  meta_mindfulness       = meta$mindfulness_holistic,
  meta_recovery          = meta$recovery_emphasis,
  meta_affect            = meta$affect_emotion,
  meta_beginner          = meta$beginner_friendly,

  # ==================
  # Aggregates (mean of IG + Meta)
  # ==================
  overall_temple         = mean(c(ig$temple_rating,  meta$temple_rating),  na.rm = TRUE),
  overall_machine        = mean(c(ig$machine_rating, meta$machine_rating), na.rm = TRUE),
  overall_avg_age        = mean(c(ig$avg_age,        meta$avg_age),        na.rm = TRUE),
  overall_pct_female     = mean(c(ig$pct_female,     meta$pct_female),     na.rm = TRUE),
  overall_muscularity    = mean(c(ig$muscularity,    meta$muscularity),    na.rm = TRUE),
  overall_leanness       = mean(c(ig$leanness,       meta$leanness),       na.rm = TRUE),
  overall_intensity      = mean(c(ig$intensity_of_activity, meta$intensity_of_activity), na.rm = TRUE),
  overall_diversity      = mean(c(ig$racial_ethnic_diversity, meta$racial_ethnic_diversity), na.rm = TRUE),
  overall_age_range      = mean(c(ig$age_range_breadth, meta$age_range_breadth), na.rm = TRUE),
  overall_tech           = mean(c(ig$tech_emphasis, meta$tech_emphasis),   na.rm = TRUE),
  overall_luxury         = mean(c(ig$luxury_cues, meta$luxury_cues),       na.rm = TRUE),
  overall_performance    = mean(c(ig$performance_cues, meta$performance_cues), na.rm = TRUE),
  overall_community      = mean(c(ig$community_orientation, meta$community_orientation), na.rm = TRUE),
  overall_transformation = mean(c(ig$transformation_messaging, meta$transformation_messaging), na.rm = TRUE),
  overall_mindfulness    = mean(c(ig$mindfulness_holistic, meta$mindfulness_holistic), na.rm = TRUE),
  overall_recovery       = mean(c(ig$recovery_emphasis, meta$recovery_emphasis),     na.rm = TRUE),
  overall_affect         = mean(c(ig$affect_emotion, meta$affect_emotion),           na.rm = TRUE),
  overall_beginner       = mean(c(ig$beginner_friendly, meta$beginner_friendly),           na.rm = TRUE)
)
})

# ------------------------------
# 7) SAVE
# ------------------------------
write_csv(results, "PoB_ChatGPT.csv")
message("\n🎉 Done! Saved to PoB_ChatGPT.csv")
print(results)
